mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, promotion_domain_id AS promotionDomainId, theme_color AS themeColor, is_app_download_shown AS isAppDownloadShown, target_country_value AS targetCountry, preselected_country_value AS preselectedCountry, platform, is_in_app_open_allowed AS isInAppOpenAllowed, is_marketing_allowed AS isMarketingAllowed, status, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM promotion_channel WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id, c.channel_name AS channelName, c.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, c.target_country_value AS targetCountry, d.landing_template_id AS landingTemplateId, d.domain_host AS domain, c.preselected_country_value AS preselectedCountry, c.theme_color AS themeColor, c.is_app_download_shown AS isAppDownloadShown, c.platform, tc.tracking_id AS trackingId, CASE WHEN tc.access_token_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND tc.encryption_key_id IS NOT NULL AND tc.token_fingerprint IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS accessTokenConfigured, tc.lead_event_name AS leadEventName, tc.login_request_event_name AS loginRequestEventName, tc.login_success_event_name AS loginSuccessEventName, c.is_in_app_open_allowed AS isInAppOpenAllowed, c.is_marketing_allowed AS isMarketingAllowed, c.status FROM promotion_channel c INNER JOIN promotion_domain d ON d.id = c.promotion_domain_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN promotion_channel_tracking_config tc ON tc.channel_id = c.id AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT t.template_code AS templateCode, c.theme_color AS themeColor, c.is_app_download_shown AS isAppDownloadShown, c.target_country_value AS targetCountry, c.preselected_country_value AS preselectedCountry FROM promotion_domain d INNER JOIN promotion_channel c ON c.promotion_domain_id = d.id AND d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN tenant tenant_registry ON tenant_registry.id = c.tenant_id AND tenant_registry.status = 1 INNER JOIN promotion_landing_template t ON t.id = d.landing_template_id AND t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND d.domain_host = #{domainHost} AND d.is_active = 1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT c.tenant_id AS tenantId, c.id AS channelId, c.channel_name AS channelName, c.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, country.name_zh AS preferredProxyRegion, c.platform, tracking.lead_event_name AS leadEventName, tracking.login_request_event_name AS loginRequestEventName, tracking.login_success_event_name AS loginSuccessEventName FROM promotion_domain d INNER JOIN promotion_channel c ON c.promotion_domain_id = d.id AND c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN tenant tenant_registry ON tenant_registry.id = c.tenant_id AND tenant_registry.status = 1 INNER JOIN promotion_landing_template t ON t.id = d.landing_template_id AND t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.status = 1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN country ON country.iso2 = c.preselected_country_value AND country.is_enabled = 1 AND country.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN promotion_channel_tracking_config tracking ON tracking.channel_id = c.id AND tracking.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND tracking.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND d.domain_host = #{domainHost} AND d.is_active = 1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id AS channelId, c.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, c.platform, c.channel_code AS channelCode, d.domain_host AS domainHost, tc.id AS trackingConfigId, tc.tracking_id AS trackingId, tc.access_token_ciphertext AS accessTokenCiphertext, tc.encryption_key_id AS encryptionKeyId, tc.token_fingerprint AS tokenFingerprint FROM promotion_channel c INNER JOIN promotion_domain d ON d.id = c.promotion_domain_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN promotion_channel_tracking_config tc ON tc.channel_id = c.id AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_channel_tracking_config SET last_probe_status = 0, last_probe_event_name = #{row.lastProbeEventName}, last_probe_event_id = NULL, last_probe_error_code = NULL, last_probe_error_message = NULL, last_probed_at = #{row.lastProbedAt}, updated_by = #{row.updatedBy}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE channel_id = #{row.channelId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND provider_type = #{row.providerType} AND tracking_id = #{row.trackingId} AND token_fingerprint = #{row.tokenFingerprint} AND (last_probe_status IS NULL OR (last_probe_status = 0 AND (last_probed_at IS NULL OR last_probed_at <= #{staleBefore})) OR (last_probe_status <> 0 AND (last_probed_at IS NULL OR last_probed_at <= #{cooldownBefore})))

UPDATE promotion_channel SET channel_name = #{channelName}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, promotion_domain_id = #{promotionDomainId}, theme_color = COALESCE(#{themeColor}, theme_color), is_app_download_shown = COALESCE(#{isAppDownloadShown}, is_app_download_shown), target_country_value = #{targetCountry}, preselected_country_value = #{preselectedCountry}, platform = #{platform}, is_in_app_open_allowed = #{isInAppOpenAllowed}, is_marketing_allowed = #{isMarketingAllowed}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
